ivory_cloud.generator: Built-in ImageGen, transparent RGBA, Reef viewport screenshot as style reference only
ivory_cloud.prompt: Generate ONE standalone hand-painted PNG sprite for a real 2D Godot storybook game, transparent background. The input screenshot is a palette and brushwork reference only. Asset: ONE distant low cumulus cloud for the bright mountain lagoon sky. Match the ivory-white sunlit puffs and soft muted lavender-blue underside of the small pale painted clouds in the reference, with the highlight toward upper left, a wide shallow airy silhouette, three grouped rounded lobes and an understated soft trailing edge, not the large darker blue independent cloud. Only the standalone cloud, centered, wide horizontal aspect footprint about 3.3:1, with ample transparent padding. Alpha edge gracefully soft but clean. No background, no gradient covering the canvas, no border, no ground, no characters, no UI, no text.

ivory_cloud.derivative_edits: Alpha threshold used to select crop bounds, existing alpha preserved within crop, Lanczos downscale and 3 px outer transparent padding. Cue centered in 192 px square.

moss_footing.prompt: Create ONE standalone hand-painted PNG sprite asset for a 2D storybook mountain lagoon game, with genuine transparent RGBA background. Input screenshot is palette and camera-angle reference only. Asset is a low-profile elliptical patch of flattened warm moss-green meadow grass with a few small pale limestone chips embedded right at the perimeter, seen from the same shallow overhead stage angle as the lawn in the screenshot. The dark muted olive interior grades into feathered irregular grass tips, with no sharp sticker outline. The patch is wide and extremely shallow, about 4:1 footprint. Do not draw raised or freestanding rocks, flowers, equipment, cast silhouette, people, letters, borders, extra patches, canvas background or UI.

warm_footing.generator: Built-in ImageGen, transparent RGBA, Reef viewport screenshot as style reference only
warm_footing.prompt: One original 2D painted environmental game sprite on transparent RGBA, palette reference from the shown storybook mountain lagoon. Make a tiny shallow worn contact patch for a stone playground pedestal, a soft irregular oval of warm light moss and packed earth with a little grass at its edge, viewed from the same low overhead angle as the walkway. Smooth out the texture in the middle so a toy support remains clearly legible. A little warmer and lighter than the lawn while staying subdued. About 3.5 times wider than high. Ground layer only, with genuine transparent outside pixels and soft painted alpha edges. No loose stones, extra objects, signage, character, equipment, cast silhouette, floor beyond the patch, text or UI.

passes.review: The old independent blue cloud reads apart from the warmer painted sky.
The ivory and lavender paint belongs to the sky family. At the original scale it competes with nearby clouds.

passes.change: Reduce the cloud footprint and match the night grade
passes.review: The smaller cloud recedes and the blue night grade keeps it in the same value tier as the distant painted clouds.

passes.change: Ease cloud motion at both turnarounds
passes.review: The matched overview preserves the composition. A cosine cycle reduces velocity smoothly at each turnaround.

passes.change: Test a warm support patch under the seesaw
passes.review: The warm patch highlights the seesaw contact but introduces a second warm accent in the grass. It is retained as a trial.

passes.change: Compare the quieter moss support patch
passes.review: Moss gives the pivot a quieter base and separates it from the darker shrub edge. Selected over the warm trial.

passes.change: Register the swing and slide supports
passes.review: Low-alpha moss under the ladder, chute and swing feet keeps the play lane clear. The existing equipment silhouettes stay separated.

passes.change: Use the painted pearl focus ring
passes.review: The hollow pearl ring reads clearly without masking the artwork. The original pointing geometry still identifies the target.

passes.change: Anchor the pointer tip during the entire pulse
passes.review: The tip stays on the support at varying cue scales. Read the numerical pin check alongside the still.

passes.change: Tighten follow response while keeping eased camera travel
passes.review: The paired still keeps the same composition. A time-step probe verifies 0.593 camera response in 0.1 s without snapping.

passes.change: Give selected station confirmation precedence over incidental wildlife
passes.review: The paired still keeps the same composition. The live overlap probe verifies that confirmation reaches the already selected swing.
